description: Static assertions for ip-invent — offensive-IP orchestrator (ý tưởng → hồ sơ nộp đơn) commanding 5 ip-* blocks, distinct from and complementary to QP-02-06 FTO. Must preserve: B0-criteria-before-screening gate, disclosure gate, egress gate (no unpublished invention content to cloud), advisory-only stance, mandatory amendment-chain verification with printed date, 4-way routing including secret patents, fast-examination claim cap, Điều 14 foreign-filing security gate, Điều 10a AI-authorship gate, and one-block-per-turn ledger discipline. v1.1: all cross-document [\s\S]* windows bounded after a mutation test proved IP-DISCLOSE was a keyword gate — an inverted disclosure gate still passed because scattered tokens elsewhere satisfied the unbounded match. v1.2: thêm IP-WORKSPACE + IP-COMAT sau khi đóng gói thành plugin — tầng trỏ workspace và cổng phân loại bí mật nhà nước là hai cơ chế mới, không có assertion thì chúng có thể bị gỡ mà eval vẫn xanh.
test_input: lập hồ sơ sáng chế cho một cơ cấu cơ khí chưa bộc lộ, nhắm cả hai đích chức danh, cân nhắc nộp kép và khả năng nộp ra nước ngoài

assertions.name: commands_five_blocks_in_order
assertions.check: orchestrator commands the 5 ip-* block skills in pipeline order criteria -> harvest -> screen -> claim -> dossier

assertions.name: criteria_block_gates_screening
assertions.check: B0 is a blocking gate: screening cannot run without a CEO-confirmed yardstick. Inverting this to make B0 optional must fail.
assertions.regex: B0 là bắt buộc và không được bỏ qua[\s\S]{0,400}Không có thước đo

assertions.name: b0_before_b2_stated_as_rule
assertions.check: the rules section states B0 before B2 with the reason (no yardstick = cannot score the credential axis)

assertions.name: disclosure_gate_forbids_publication
assertions.check: the disclosure gate must FORBID publication before the priority date is locked. Inverting CẤM to ĐƯỢC PHÉP must fail this assertion.

assertions.name: no_unpublished_content_to_external_tools
assertions.check: forbids sending not-yet-disclosed invention content to NotebookLM/cloud/external prompts
assertions.regex: KHÔNG[\s\S]{0,12}đưa nội dung giải pháp chưa bộc lộ vào NotebookLM

assertions.name: advisory_only_not_ip_agent
assertions.check: declares it does not replace the industrial-property agent or the credential-granting authority
assertions.regex: Không thay thế[\s\S]{0,15}đại diện sở hữu công nghiệp[\s\S]{0,40}cơ quan xét chức danh

assertions.name: amendment_chain_check_is_mandatory_and_dated
assertions.check: requires every block emitting a form/spec/deadline/fee to print a dated amendment-chain check line
assertions.regex: PHẢI in dòng[\s\S]{0,80}Chuỗi sửa đổi kiểm tại

assertions.name: names_current_decree_chain
assertions.check: names the actual decree chain so a stale anchor is visible: NĐ 65/2023 -> 15/2026 -> 33/2026 -> 100/2026

assertions.name: ai_authorship_gate
assertions.check: carries the Điều 10a gate tying human substantial contribution to authorship
assertions.regex: Điều 10a[\s\S]{0,80}(xuất xứ đóng góp|đóng góp đáng kể|tác giả)

assertions.name: foreign_filing_security_gate
assertions.check: carries the Điều 14 gate — foreign filing requires prior Ministry of Defence / Public Security permission

assertions.name: four_way_routing_includes_secret_patent
assertions.check: routing has four destinations not two — sáng chế, GPHI, nộp kép, and sáng chế MẬT

assertions.name: fast_examination_claim_cap
assertions.check: surfaces the quantified fast-examination ceiling: at most 10 claim points, at most 2 independent

assertions.name: one_block_per_turn_ledger
assertions.check: _pipeline_state.md is the sole inter-block channel, not conversation memory

assertions.name: distinct_from_fto_opposite_direction
assertions.check: positions itself as the mirror of QP-02-06 FTO — FTO avoids others' claims, this builds our own
assertions.regex: tránh claim người khác[\s\S]{0,140}dựng claim của mình

assertions.name: forbids_averaging_two_axes
assertions.check: forbids collapsing the protectability axis and the credential-value axis into one averaged score

assertions.name: reads_pointer_layer_or_stops
assertions.check: orchestrator đọc tầng trỏ workspace TRƯỚC mọi việc khác và DỪNG nếu đọc không được — đảo thành 'đọc không được thì dùng mặc định' phải fail

assertions.name: cloud_surface_triggers_classification_gate
assertions.check: surface cloud kích hoạt cổng phân loại trước khi đụng nội dung ứng viên
